decisions.reason: The gas tariff comparison sits close to the core tariff database, has its own page and costs little to maintain, so this cheap option is worth holding while its value plays out.
The electricity tariff calculator is a low-cost extension of the maintained market data, and nothing so far shows its value will fail to materialize.

This multi-model line is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with Product C, so consolidation is a real possibility, but upkeep on shared databases is cheap and uncertainty remains, so the option stays open.
The area definition tool underpins the other location-based products on the central platform, so keeping it costs little and raises the value of the related options.
The site-specific comparison line partly overlaps with Product B and has low visibility, but its prospects are not yet resolved and maintenance is cheap, so it is kept for now.
